name: Zechariah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: And he sought God in the days of Zechariah, who had understanding in the visions of God: and as long as he sought the Lord, God made him to prosper. Zechariah was a prophet. He sought God when Zechariah was around — meaning who was helping him? God had the right men around this young man to tutor him and to guide him. He was a young king, but he prospered once he sought the Lord.

note.label: The Mind of a Child: Void of Ego and Pride

points: He sought the Most High in the days of Zechariah, who had understanding in the visions of God, and as long as he sought the Most High, God made him to prosper. Prosperity comes from the Most High, and it lasts only as long as a man keeps seeking Him.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 26: Uzziah Prospers, Then Pride Brings Him Low
